readme.markdown: # Courier MCP Server The official [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) (MCP) server for the [Courier](https://www.courier.com) notification API. It gives AI agents full access to the Courier API — send messages, manage profiles, debug deliveries, configure lists, and more — through 124 tools backed by the [`@trycourier/courier`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@trycourier/courier) Node SDK. ## Install ### Hosted (recommended) Courier runs a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.courier.com`. No local setup required. **Cursor** — add to `.cursor/mcp.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "Courier": { "url": "https://mcp.courier.com", "headers": { "api_key": "YOUR_COURIER_API_KEY" } } } } ``` **Claude Code:** ```bash claude mcp add Courier --transport http --url https://mcp.courier.com --header "api_key: YOUR_COURIER_API_KEY" ``` **Claude Desktop** — add to `claude_desktop_config.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "Courier": { "url": "https://mcp.courier.com", "headers": { "api_key": "YOUR_COURIER_API_KEY" } } } } ``` ### Local development ```bash git clone https://github.com/trycourier/courier-mcp.git cd courier-mcp sh dev.sh ``` Then point your IDE at `http://localhost:3000` with the same config format above. ## Tools 123 default tools organized by API resource, plus 1 diagnostic tool available in local installs. ### Default tools | Category | Tools | |----------|-------| | **Send** | `send_message`, `send_message_template`, `send_message_to_list`, `send_message_to_list_template` | | **Messages** | `list_messages`, `get_message`, `get_message_content`, `get_message_history`, `cancel_message` | | **Profiles** | `get_user_profile_by_id`, `create_or_merge_user`, `replace_profile`, `patch_profile`, `delete_profile`, `get_user_list_subscriptions`, `subscribe_user_to_lists`, `delete_user_list_subscriptions` | | **Lists** | `list_lists`, `get_list`, `get_list_subscribers`, `create_list`, `delete_list`, `restore_list`, `subscribe_user_to_list`, `unsubscribe_user_from_list`, `bulk_subscribe_to_list`, `add_subscribers_to_list` | | **Audiences** | `get_audience`, `list_audience_members`, `list_audiences`, `update_audience`, `delete_audience` | | **Notifications** | `list_notifications`, `get_notification`, `get_notification_content`, `get_notification_draft_content`, `create_notification`, `replace_notification`, `archive_notification`, `publish_notification`, `list_notification_versions`, `list_notification_checks`, `update_notification_checks`, `put_notification_content`, `put_notification_element`, `put_notification_locale`, `cancel_notification_submission` | | **Brands** | `create_brand`, `get_brand`, `list_brands`, `update_brand`, `delete_brand` | | **Auth** | `generate_jwt_for_user` | | **Device Tokens** | `list_user_push_tokens`, `get_user_push_token`, `create_or_replace_user_push_token`, `bulk_add_user_tokens`, `patch_user_token`, `delete_user_token` | | **Docs** | `courier_installation_guide` | | **Automations** | `invoke_automation_template`, `invoke_ad_hoc_automation`, `list_automations`, `cancel_automation` | | **Bulk** | `create_bulk_job`, `add_bulk_users`, `run_bulk_job`, `get_bulk_job`, `list_bulk_users` | | **Audit Events** | `get_audit_event`, `list_audit_events` | | **Inbound** | `track_inbound_event` | | **Tenants** | `get_tenant`, `create_or_update_tenant`, `list_tenants`, `delete_tenant`, `list_tenant_users`, `update_tenant_preference`, `delete_tenant_preference`, `list_tenant_templates`, `get_tenant_template`, `replace_tenant_template`, `publish_tenant_template`, `get_tenant_template_version`, `delete_tenant_template` | | **Users** | `get_user_preferences`, `get_user_preference_topic`, `update_user_preference_topic`, `list_user_tenants`, `add_user_to_tenant`, `remove_user_from_tenant`, `bulk_add_user_tenants`, `remove_all_user_tenants` | | **Routing Strategies** | `create_routing_strategy`, `get_routing_strategy`, `replace_routing_strategy`, `archive_routing_strategy`, `list_routing_strategies`, `list_routing_strategy_notifications` | | **Journeys** | `list_journeys`, `invoke_journey`, `create_journey`, `get_journey`, `replace_journey`, `publish_journey`, `archive_journey`, `list_journey_versions`, `list_journey_templates`, `create_journey_template`, `get_journey_template`, `replace_journey_template`, `archive_journey_template`, `publish_journey_template`, `list_journey_template_versions` | | **Requests** | `archive_request` | | **Providers** | `list_providers`, `get_provider`, `list_provider_catalog`, `create_provider`, `update_provider`, `delete_provider` | | **Translations** | `get_translation`, `update_translation` | ### Diagnostic tools (local only) | Category | Tools | |----------|-------| | **Config** | `get_environment_config` — check which API key, base URL, and package version the MCP session is using | ### Safer defaults (optional client policies) Tools that send live traffic, carry `destructiveHint` in MCP annotations, or mutate provider integrations are listed in code as `RECOMMENDED_CLIENT_DISABLED_TOOLS` ([source](mcp/src/policy/recommended-client-disabled-tools.ts)). Export it from `@trycourier/courier-mcp` if you want to drive codegen or docs. Teams typically paste subsets into **Claude Code** (`permissions.deny` / `mcp____`) or **Codex** (`[mcp_servers..disabled_tools]` in `config.toml`). This does not change hosted MCP behavior until each client applies its own policy. ## Architecture ``` courier-mcp/ ├── mcp/ # MCP package (@trycourier/courier-mcp on npm) │ └── src/ │ ├── index.ts # CourierMcp server class │ ├── policy/ # Optional client policy helpers (e.g. recommended disable list) │ ├── tools/ # Tool definitions (one file per API resource) │ └── utils/ # Config, error handling, registry ├── server/ # Express server (hosts the MCP package via HTTP) │ └── src/index.ts # Stateless HTTP handler └── dev.sh # Local development launcher ``` The MCP package uses the official `@trycourier/courier` Node SDK (Stainless-generated) for all API calls. The SDK stays in sync with the Courier API spec automatically, so tool implementations are thin wrappers with proper error handling. ## Configuration | Header | Required | Description | |--------|----------|-------------| | `api_key` | Yes | Your Courier API key. Get one at [app.courier.com/settings/api-keys](https://app.courier.com/settings/api-keys). | | `base_url` | No | Override the API base URL. Defaults to `https://api.courier.com`. | ## Development ```bash # Install dependencies cd mcp && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd .. # Start development server sh dev.sh # Run tests cd mcp && npm test # Build cd mcp && npm run build ``` ## SDK dependency updates The `@trycourier/courier` SDK dependency in `mcp/` is updated automatically via [Dependabot](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/dependabot). Dependabot checks npm daily and opens a PR when a new SDK version is available. - **Patch/minor bumps**: review CI status, then merge. - **Major bumps** (labeled `breaking-review`): check whether any tool input schemas or error handling need updates before merging. After merging a Dependabot PR, the full pipeline runs automatically: 1. `auto-version-bump.yml` bumps the MCP package patch version and pushes to main. 2. `publish-npm.yml` publishes the new version to npm. 3. `bump-services.yml` opens a PR in `trycourier/services` to update the hosted MCP server. **Secrets required** (set in repo Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions): - `REPO_TOKEN` — PAT with `Contents: Read and write` on this repo. Used by `auto-version-bump.yml` to push to main and trigger downstream workflows. - `SERVICES_REPO_TOKEN` — PAT with `Contents: Read and write` + `Pull requests: Read and write` on `trycourier/services`. Used by `bump-services.yml` to open dependency bump PRs. - `NPM_TOKEN` — npm publish token. Used by `publish-npm.yml`. ## Links - [Courier docs](https://www.courier.com/docs/) - [MCP documentation page](https://www.courier.com/docs/tools/mcp/) - [AI developer tools overview](https://www.courier.com/docs/tools/ai-onboarding/) - [Courier Node SDK](https://github.com/trycourier/courier-node) - [MCP protocol spec](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/)

toolsPreview.name: list_messages
toolsPreview.description: List messages you've previously sent. Filter by status, recipient, notification, provider, tags, or tenant.

toolsPreview.name: get_message
toolsPreview.description: Get the full details and status of a single message by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_message_content
toolsPreview.description: Get the rendered content (HTML, text, subject) of a previously sent message.

toolsPreview.name: get_message_history
toolsPreview.description: Get the event history for a message, showing each step in the delivery pipeline (enqueued, sent, delivered, etc.).

toolsPreview.name: list_notifications
toolsPreview.description: List notification templates. Optionally filter by cursor.

toolsPreview.name: get_notification_content
toolsPreview.description: Get the published content blocks of a notification template.

toolsPreview.name: list_providers
toolsPreview.description: List configured provider integrations for the workspace.

toolsPreview.name: get_provider
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single provider configuration by ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_routing_strategy
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a routing strategy by ID. Returns the full entity including routing, channels, and providers.

toolsPreview.name: list_preference_sections
toolsPreview.description: List the workspace's preference sections. Each section embeds its topics.

toolsPreview.name: get_audience
toolsPreview.description: Get an audience by its ID, including its filter definition.

toolsPreview.name: list_audience_members
toolsPreview.description: List all members of an audience.

toolsPreview.name: list_audiences
toolsPreview.description: List all audiences in the workspace.

toolsPreview.name: update_audience
toolsPreview.description: Create or update an audience with a filter definition.

toolsPreview.name: delete_audience
toolsPreview.description: Delete an audience by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_audit_event
toolsPreview.description: Get a specific audit event by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: list_audit_events
toolsPreview.description: List audit events in the workspace. Useful for tracking API usage and changes.

toolsPreview.name: generate_jwt_for_user
toolsPreview.description: Generate a JWT authentication token for a user. Used for client-side SDK auth (Inbox, Preferences, etc.).

toolsPreview.name: invoke_automation_template
toolsPreview.description: Invoke an automation run from an existing automation template. Call list_automations first to get the template_id. Example: { template_id: "auto-onboarding", recipient: "user-123", data: { plan: "pro" } }.

toolsPreview.name: invoke_ad_hoc_automation
toolsPreview.description: Invoke an ad-hoc automation with inline steps. Valid step actions: send, send-list, delay, cancel, update-profile, invoke, fetch-data. To cancel a previously started automation, use the cancel_automation tool instead.

toolsPreview.name: list_automations
toolsPreview.description: List automation templates in the workspace. Always call this first to discover template_id values before calling invoke_automation_template. Optionally filter by version.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_automation
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a running automation by its cancelation_token. This invokes a second ad-hoc automation with a single cancel step. The token must match the cancelation_token set when the original automation was started. Note: spelling is "cancelation_token" (single "l").

toolsPreview.name: create_brand
toolsPreview.description: Create a new brand. The API requires settings — omitting it returns a 400. If you do not have specific brand colors, omit settings and a safe default will be used automatically (black primary, white secondary). Example: { name: "Acme", settings: { colors: { primary: "#1a73e8", secondary: "#ffffff" } } }.

toolsPreview.name: get_brand
toolsPreview.description: Get a brand by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: list_brands
toolsPreview.description: List all brands in the workspace.

toolsPreview.name: update_brand
toolsPreview.description: Replace an existing brand with new values.

toolsPreview.name: delete_brand
toolsPreview.description: Delete a brand by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: create_bulk_job
toolsPreview.description: Create a new bulk job for sending messages to multiple recipients. Workflow: create_bulk_job → add_bulk_users → run_bulk_job.

toolsPreview.name: add_bulk_users
toolsPreview.description: Add users to an existing bulk job.

toolsPreview.name: run_bulk_job
toolsPreview.description: Run a bulk job, triggering delivery to all added users.

toolsPreview.name: get_bulk_job
toolsPreview.description: Get the status of a bulk job.

toolsPreview.name: list_bulk_users
toolsPreview.description: List the users in a bulk job.

toolsPreview.name: courier_installation_guide
toolsPreview.description: Get the Courier SDK installation guide for a specific platform. For client-side SDKs (React, iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native), also generates a sample JWT.

toolsPreview.name: track_inbound_event
toolsPreview.description: Track an inbound event that can trigger automations. Requires event name, messageId (for deduplication), and properties.

toolsPreview.name: list_lists
toolsPreview.description: Get all lists. Optionally filter by pattern (e.g. 'example.list.*').

toolsPreview.name: get_list
toolsPreview.description: Get a list by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_list_subscribers
toolsPreview.description: Get all subscribers of a list.

toolsPreview.name: create_list
toolsPreview.description: Create or update a list by list ID.

toolsPreview.name: subscribe_user_to_list
toolsPreview.description: Subscribe a user to a list. Creates the list if it doesn't exist.

toolsPreview.name: unsubscribe_user_from_list
toolsPreview.description: Unsubscribe a user from a list.

toolsPreview.name: delete_list
toolsPreview.description: Delete a list by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: restore_list
toolsPreview.description: Restore a previously deleted list.

toolsPreview.name: bulk_subscribe_to_list
toolsPreview.description: Replace all subscribers on a list with the given recipients.

toolsPreview.name: add_subscribers_to_list
toolsPreview.description: Append subscribers to a list without removing existing subscribers.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_message
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a message that is currently being delivered. Returns the message details with updated status.

toolsPreview.name: resend_message
toolsPreview.description: Resend a previously sent message. Loads the original send request and enqueues a brand-new send to the same recipient with the same content, producing a new messageId; the original message is unchanged. Rate limited per message (429 on rapid repeats).

toolsPreview.name: get_notification_draft_content
toolsPreview.description: Get the draft (unpublished) content blocks of a notification template.

toolsPreview.name: create_notification
toolsPreview.description: Create a V2 notification template. name is required. Provide content inline or set it immediately after creation via put_notification_content. To send with this template you must publish it first via publish_notification (or pass state: 'PUBLISHED' on create). Link a routing strategy via notification.routing.strategy_id to control which channels are used. Example: { notification: { name: 'welcome-email', tags: [], brand: null, subscription: null, routing: { strategy_id: 'rs_01abc' }, content: { version: '2022-01-01', elements: [] } } }.

toolsPreview.name: get_notification
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a notification template by ID. Optionally request draft, published, or a version such as v001.

toolsPreview.name: replace_notification
toolsPreview.description: Replace a notification template entirely (full document PUT).

toolsPreview.name: archive_notification
toolsPreview.description: Archive a notification template by ID.

toolsPreview.name: list_notification_versions
toolsPreview.description: List version history for a notification template.

toolsPreview.name: publish_notification
toolsPreview.description: Publish a notification template, making it available for sending. Must be called before send_message_template unless the template was created with state: 'PUBLISHED'. Publishes the current draft by default; pass version (e.g. 'v001') to publish a specific historical version. Returns 204 on success.

toolsPreview.name: list_notification_checks
toolsPreview.description: List checks for a notification submission.

toolsPreview.name: update_notification_checks
toolsPreview.description: Update check statuses for a notification submission.

toolsPreview.name: put_notification_content
toolsPreview.description: Replace the elemental content of a V2 notification template. Overwrites all elements. Use channel elements to target specific channels. Multi-channel example: elements: [{ type: "channel", channel: "email", elements: [{ type: "meta", title: "Hello" }, { type: "text", content: "Email body" }] }, { type: "channel", channel: "push", elements: [{ type: "meta", title: "Hello" }, { type: "text", content: "Push body" }] }, { type: "channel", channel: "inbox", elements: [{ type: "text", content: "Inbox plain text only" }] }].

toolsPreview.name: put_notification_element
toolsPreview.description: Update a single element within a V2 notification template.

toolsPreview.name: put_notification_locale
toolsPreview.description: Set locale-specific content overrides for a V2 notification template. Each element override must reference an existing element by its id. Example for Spanish locale: { notification_id: "nt_01abc", locale_id: "es", elements: [{ id: "elem_meta_1", title: "Restablecer contraseña" }, { id: "elem_text_1", content: "Haga clic en el enlace para restablecer su contraseña." }] }.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_notification_submission
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a notification template submission.

toolsPreview.name: get_user_profile_by_id
toolsPreview.description: Get a user profile by their ID. Returns profile data including email, phone, and custom properties.

toolsPreview.name: create_or_merge_user
toolsPreview.description: Create a new user profile or merge supplied values into an existing profile (POST). Existing fields not included are preserved.

toolsPreview.name: replace_profile
toolsPreview.description: Fully replace a user profile (PUT). All existing data is overwritten; include every field you want to keep.

toolsPreview.name: patch_profile
toolsPreview.description: Partially update a user profile via JSON Patch (RFC 6902). Use add/replace/remove operations on specific profile paths.

toolsPreview.name: delete_profile
toolsPreview.description: Delete a user profile permanently.

toolsPreview.name: get_user_list_subscriptions
toolsPreview.description: Get all list subscriptions for a user.

toolsPreview.name: subscribe_user_to_lists
toolsPreview.description: Subscribe a user to one or more lists. Creates lists that do not exist.

toolsPreview.name: delete_user_list_subscriptions
toolsPreview.description: Delete all list subscriptions for a user.

toolsPreview.name: send_message
toolsPreview.description: Send a message to a user using inline title and body content (no template). Optionally specify routing channels.

toolsPreview.name: send_message_template
toolsPreview.description: Send a message to a user using a published notification template. The template must be published before sending — call publish_notification first if needed. Example: { user_id: "user-123", template: "nt_01abc123", data: { name: "Alex", resetUrl: "https://app.example.com/reset" } }.

toolsPreview.name: send_message_to_list
toolsPreview.description: Send a message to all subscribers of a list using inline title and body content.

toolsPreview.name: send_message_to_list_template
toolsPreview.description: Send a message to all subscribers of a list using a notification template.

toolsPreview.name: get_tenant
toolsPreview.description: Get a tenant by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: create_or_update_tenant
toolsPreview.description: Create or replace a tenant. Tenants represent organizations or groups that users belong to.

toolsPreview.name: list_tenants
toolsPreview.description: List all tenants in the workspace.

toolsPreview.name: delete_tenant
toolsPreview.description: Delete a tenant by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: list_tenant_users
toolsPreview.description: List users associated with a tenant.

toolsPreview.name: update_tenant_preference
toolsPreview.description: Set the default notification preference for a subscription topic on a tenant. This controls tenant-level defaults — it does NOT set per-user preferences (use the user preferences API for that). The topic_id must already exist as a subscription topic in the workspace; a 404 means the topic has not been created yet. Example: { tenant_id: "acme", topic_id: "marketing-updates", status: "OPTED_IN", has_custom_routing: true, custom_routing: ["email", "push"] }.

toolsPreview.name: delete_tenant_preference
toolsPreview.description: Remove default notification preference for a topic from a tenant.

toolsPreview.name: list_tenant_templates
toolsPreview.description: List notification templates configured for a tenant.

toolsPreview.name: get_tenant_template
toolsPreview.description: Get a tenant notification template association by template ID.

toolsPreview.name: replace_tenant_template
toolsPreview.description: Create or replace a tenant notification template (draft unless published is true).

toolsPreview.name: publish_tenant_template
toolsPreview.description: Publish a version of a tenant notification template.

toolsPreview.name: get_tenant_template_version
toolsPreview.description: Get a specific version of a tenant notification template (e.g. latest, published, or v1).

toolsPreview.name: delete_tenant_template
toolsPreview.description: Delete a tenant notification template. Returns 204 on success, 404 if the template does not exist for this tenant.

toolsPreview.name: get_translation
toolsPreview.description: Get a translation for a specific locale (e.g. "en_US", "fr_FR").

toolsPreview.name: update_translation
toolsPreview.description: Create or update a translation for a specific locale.

toolsPreview.name: list_user_push_tokens
toolsPreview.description: List all push/device tokens for a user.

toolsPreview.name: get_user_push_token
toolsPreview.description: Get a specific push/device token for a user.

toolsPreview.name: create_or_replace_user_push_token
toolsPreview.description: Create or replace a push/device token for a user.

toolsPreview.name: bulk_add_user_tokens
toolsPreview.description: Add multiple push/device tokens for a user in one request. Overwrites matching existing tokens.

toolsPreview.name: patch_user_token
toolsPreview.description: Apply a JSON Patch (RFC 6902) to a specific push token.

toolsPreview.name: delete_user_token
toolsPreview.description: Delete a specific push token for a user.

toolsPreview.name: get_user_preferences
toolsPreview.description: Get a user's notification preferences (subscriptions, opt-outs, channel preferences).

toolsPreview.name: get_user_preference_topic
toolsPreview.description: Get a user's preference for a specific subscription topic.

toolsPreview.name: update_user_preference_topic
toolsPreview.description: Update a user's preference for a specific subscription topic (opt in, opt out, or set channel preferences).

toolsPreview.name: delete_user_preference_topic
toolsPreview.description: Delete a user's preference for a specific subscription topic, reverting it to the topic's default status.

toolsPreview.name: list_user_tenants
toolsPreview.description: List all tenants a user belongs to.

toolsPreview.name: add_user_to_tenant
toolsPreview.description: Add a user to a tenant.

toolsPreview.name: remove_user_from_tenant
toolsPreview.description: Remove a user from a tenant.

toolsPreview.name: bulk_add_user_tenants
toolsPreview.description: Add a user to multiple tenants at once. A custom profile can be supplied per tenant.

toolsPreview.name: remove_all_user_tenants
toolsPreview.description: Remove a user from all tenants.

toolsPreview.name: bulk_update_user_preferences
toolsPreview.description: Additively create or update a user's preferences for one or more topics in a single request. Only the topics in the body are touched; existing overrides for other topics are left untouched. Partial-success: valid topics are written and returned in `items`, unapplicable ones collected in `errors`.

toolsPreview.name: bulk_replace_user_preferences
toolsPreview.description: Replace a user's complete set of preference overrides in one request. The topics in the body become the recipient's entire override set: listed topics are created or updated, and every existing override not included is reset to its topic default. An empty `topics` array clears all overrides. Validation-atomic (all-or-nothing).

toolsPreview.name: archive_request
toolsPreview.description: Archive a send request and all its associated messages by request ID.

toolsPreview.name: create_routing_strategy
toolsPreview.description: Create a routing strategy defining how notifications are delivered across channels and providers.

toolsPreview.name: replace_routing_strategy
toolsPreview.description: Replace a routing strategy. Full document replacement; missing optional fields are cleared.

toolsPreview.name: archive_routing_strategy
toolsPreview.description: Archive a routing strategy. The strategy must not have associated notification templates; unlink all templates before archiving.

toolsPreview.name: list_routing_strategies
toolsPreview.description: List routing strategies in the workspace. Returns metadata only; use get for full details.

toolsPreview.name: list_routing_strategy_notifications
toolsPreview.description: List notification templates associated with a routing strategy. Useful for checking linked templates before archiving.

toolsPreview.name: list_journeys
toolsPreview.description: List journey templates in the workspace. Call this first to discover journey IDs before calling invoke_journey, get_journey, or replace_journey. Optionally filter by version (published or draft).

toolsPreview.name: invoke_journey
toolsPreview.description: Invoke a journey run from a journey template. Call list_journeys first to find the template_id. Example: { template_id: "j-onboarding", user_id: "user-123", data: { plan: "pro" } }.

toolsPreview.name: create_journey
toolsPreview.description: Create a new journey. Defaults to DRAFT state. Send nodes are not allowed on create — create the shell with a trigger node, then call replace_journey to add send nodes after linking notification templates. Call publish_journey to make it live. Node ids are server-generated; do NOT include an id field. Example: { name: "Welcome Journey", nodes: [{ type: "trigger", trigger_type: "api-invoke" }], enabled: true }.

toolsPreview.name: get_journey
toolsPreview.description: Get a journey by ID. Pass version=draft to retrieve the working draft, or version=vN for a historical version. Defaults to published.

toolsPreview.name: replace_journey
toolsPreview.description: Replace (update) a journey draft. Full document replacement — include all nodes and properties in the body. Call publish_journey afterwards to make changes live, or pass state: "PUBLISHED" to publish immediately. Send node template IDs must already be scoped to this journey.

toolsPreview.name: publish_journey
toolsPreview.description: Publish the current draft of a journey, making it live and invokable. Pass version to roll back to a prior published version instead of publishing the draft. Returns 404 if there is no draft to publish.

toolsPreview.name: archive_journey
toolsPreview.description: Archive a journey. Archived journeys cannot be invoked but existing runs continue to completion.

toolsPreview.name: list_journey_versions
toolsPreview.description: List published versions of a journey, ordered most recent first.

toolsPreview.name: list_journey_templates
toolsPreview.description: List notification templates scoped to a journey. Journey-scoped templates can only be used by send nodes within the same journey. Call this to discover template IDs before wiring send nodes in replace_journey.

toolsPreview.name: create_journey_template
toolsPreview.description: Create a notification template scoped to a journey. Defaults to DRAFT; pass state: "PUBLISHED" to publish on create. The template can then be referenced in journey send nodes. Example: { journey_id: "j-abc", channel: "email", notification: { name: "Welcome Email", tags: [], brand: null, subscription: null, content: { version: "2022-01-01", elements: [{ type: "text", content: "Hello!" }] } } }.

toolsPreview.name: get_journey_template
toolsPreview.description: Get a journey-scoped notification template by notification ID. Pass version=draft to retrieve the working draft (required before the template has been published). Defaults to published.

toolsPreview.name: replace_journey_template
toolsPreview.description: Replace the draft of a journey-scoped notification template. Full document replacement. Call publish_journey_template afterwards to make it live.

toolsPreview.name: archive_journey_template
toolsPreview.description: Archive a journey-scoped notification template. Archived templates cannot be sent.

toolsPreview.name: publish_journey_template
toolsPreview.description: Publish the current draft of a journey-scoped notification template. Optionally pass version to roll back to a prior version.

toolsPreview.name: list_journey_template_versions
toolsPreview.description: List published versions of a journey-scoped notification template, ordered most recent first.

toolsPreview.name: get_journey_template_content
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the elemental content of a journey-scoped notification template. Pass version=draft for the working draft, or vN for a historical version. Defaults to published.

toolsPreview.name: put_journey_template_content
toolsPreview.description: Replace the elemental content of a journey-scoped notification template. Overwrites all elements. Call publish_journey_template afterwards to make it live.

toolsPreview.name: put_journey_template_locale
toolsPreview.description: Set locale-specific content overrides for a journey-scoped notification template. Each element override must reference an existing element by its id.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_journey
toolsPreview.description: Cancel journey runs. Supply EXACTLY ONE of cancelation_token (cancels every run associated with the token) or run_id (cancels a single run). Cancelation is idempotent: a run that already finished or was already canceled is left unchanged.

toolsPreview.name: list_provider_catalog
toolsPreview.description: List available provider types from the catalog with their configuration schemas.

toolsPreview.name: create_provider
toolsPreview.description: Create a new provider (integration) configuration. Once routing strategies or notification templates reference this config, credential or settings mistakes can affect live sends—confirm provider key and settings against list_provider_catalog before saving. The provider field must be a known Courier provider key.

toolsPreview.name: update_provider
toolsPreview.description: Replace an existing provider configuration. Full replacement — retrieve current config with get_provider first; omitted optional fields are cleared. Changing API keys or settings affects live delivery if this integration is in use.

toolsPreview.name: delete_provider
toolsPreview.description: Delete a provider configuration. Returns 409 if the provider is still referenced by routing or notifications.

toolsPreview.name: create_preference_section
toolsPreview.description: Create a preference section in your workspace. The section id is generated and returned. Add topics afterwards with create_preference_topic.

toolsPreview.name: get_preference_section
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a preference section by id, including its topics.

toolsPreview.name: replace_preference_section
toolsPreview.description: Replace a preference section. Full document replacement; missing optional fields are cleared. Topics attached to the section are unaffected.

toolsPreview.name: archive_preference_section
toolsPreview.description: Archive a preference section. The section must be empty: delete its topics first, otherwise the request fails with 409.

toolsPreview.name: publish_preferences
toolsPreview.description: Publish the workspace's preferences page. Takes a snapshot of every section with its topics under a new published version, making the current state visible on the hosted preferences page.

toolsPreview.name: list_preference_topics
toolsPreview.description: List the topics in a preference section.

toolsPreview.name: create_preference_topic
toolsPreview.description: Create a subscription preference topic inside a section. The topic id is generated and returned. Fails with 404 if the section does not exist.

toolsPreview.name: get_preference_topic
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a topic within a section. Returns 404 if the section or topic does not exist, or the topic belongs to a different section.

toolsPreview.name: replace_preference_topic
toolsPreview.description: Replace a topic within a section. Full document replacement; missing optional fields are cleared.

toolsPreview.name: archive_preference_topic
toolsPreview.description: Archive a topic within a section.

toolsPreview.name: release_digest
toolsPreview.description: Release a digest schedule early — send what users have collected so far now instead of waiting for the scheduled time. A 204 is also returned when the schedule has no in-progress instances to release.

toolsPreview.name: list_digest_instances
toolsPreview.description: List the digest instances for a schedule. Each instance represents the events accumulated for a single user against the schedule, useful for monitoring accumulation before a digest is released.
